meta.name: bid-strategy-planner
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "pick a bid strategy", "set a tCPA/tROAS target", or "plan the learning-phase entry"; produces a bid-strategy choice (tCPA / tROAS / max-conversions / manual CPC), the starting target math, a portfolio grouping map, and a learning-phase entry plan. Not for splitting the budget across campaigns — use budget-optimizer; not for in-flight pacing/scale moves — use budget-pacing-monitor; not for scoring the account — use ad-account-auditor. 出价策略/tCPA目标/tROAS/学习期

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为广告活动选择最优出价策略并规划学习期
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在管理广告账户，需要科学选择出价策略并设定目标。
copy.tagline_en: Choose the optimal bid strategy for ad campaigns and plan the learning phase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage ad accounts and need to scientifically select bid strategies and set targets.

howto.what: 当用户要求选择出价策略或设定tCPA/tROAS目标时，Claude会分析转化历史，推荐tCPA、tROAS、最大化转化或手动CPC中的一种，并给出起始目标、组合分组和学习期进入计划。
howto.when: 当用户要求“选择出价策略”、“设定tCPA/tROAS目标”或“规划学习期进入”时触发。不用于预算分配或飞行中调整。

say.text: 帮我为这个广告系列选择出价策略，目标是直接转化。
say.note: Claude会分析转化历史并推荐策略。

say.text: 设定一个起始tROAS目标，历史ROAS是3.8倍。
say.note: Claude会基于历史数据计算起始目标。

say.text: 把这4个搜索广告系列分组到一个出价组合，并规划学习期。
say.note: Claude会创建组合映射和学习期计划。

howto.what_en: When asked to pick a bid strategy or set a tCPA/tROAS target, Claude analyzes conversion history and recommends one of tCPA, tROAS, max-conversions, or manual CPC, along with a starting target, portfolio grouping, and learning-phase entry plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to "pick a bid strategy", "set a tCPA/tROAS target", or "plan the learning-phase entry". Not for budget allocation or in-flight pacing.

say_en.text: Pick a bid strategy for this campaign with a DR goal.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes history and recommends a strategy.

say_en.text: Set a starting tROAS target based on 3.8x historical ROAS.
say_en.note: Claude derives the target from historical data.

say_en.text: Group these 4 search campaigns into a bid portfolio and plan learning-phase entry.
say_en.note: Claude creates portfolio map and entry plan.
